description: This file defines structures and functions to parse and model network statistics from /proc/<pid>/net/netstat in Linux, specifically focusing on TCP extension metrics and IP extension metrics, as part of the Prometheus procfs package.

classes.name: ProcNetstat
classes.description: Models the content of /proc/<pid>/net/netstat, including TCP and IP extension metrics.

classes.name: TcpExt
classes.description: Contains various TCP extension metrics as float64 pointers.

classes.name: IpExt
classes.description: Contains various IP extension metrics as float64 pointers.

methods.name: Proc.Netstat
methods.description: Reads and parses the /proc/<pid>/net/netstat file for a given process ID.

methods.name: parseProcNetstat
methods.description: Parses the network statistics from an io.Reader and returns a ProcNetstat structure.
